```{r}
# Combine per-sample Tier 1 MAF files
maf_list <- list()

for (maf_file in maf_files) {
  sample_name <- basename(maf_file)
  sample_name <- sub("\\.tier1\\.common\\.maf$", "", sample_name)

  message("Reading: ", maf_file)

  dt <- tryCatch(
    {
      fread(
        maf_file,
        sep = "\t",
        header = TRUE,
        data.table = TRUE,
        skip = "Hugo_Symbol",
        fill = TRUE,
        quote = ""
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("WARNING: Could not read MAF: ", maf_file)
      message("Reason: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(dt)) {
    next
  }

  if (nrow(dt) == 0) {
    message("WARNING: Empty MAF file: ", maf_file)
    next
  }

  if (!"Tumor_Sample_Barcode" %in% colnames(dt)) {
    dt[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := sample_name]
  }

  dt[
    is.na(Tumor_Sample_Barcode) | Tumor_Sample_Barcode == "",
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode := sample_name
  ]

  dt[, Source_MAF_File := basename(maf_file)]

  maf_list[[sample_name]] <- dt
}

if (length(maf_list) == 0) {
  stop("No non-empty MAF files were successfully read.")
}

combined_maf <- rbindlist(maf_list, fill = TRUE)

nrow(combined_maf)
length(unique(combined_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode))
```
```{r}
# Remove duplicate variant rows
dedup_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "End_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"
)

dedup_cols_present <- dedup_cols[dedup_cols %in% colnames(combined_maf)]

n_before <- nrow(combined_maf)

if (length(dedup_cols_present) >= 5) {
  combined_maf <- unique(combined_maf, by = dedup_cols_present)
}

n_after <- nrow(combined_maf)

data.table(
  Rows_before_duplicate_removal = n_before,
  Rows_after_duplicate_removal = n_after,
  Duplicates_removed = n_before - n_after
)
```

```{r}
## Breast cancer-relevant somatic interaction analysis

# ============================================================
# Somatic interaction analysis restricted to breast cancer genes
# ============================================================

# This uses the breast_genes list already defined above for the
# breast cancer gene-focused oncoplot.

present_breast_genes <- breast_genes[breast_genes %in% gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol]
missing_breast_genes <- setdiff(breast_genes, present_breast_genes)

# Summary of breast cancer genes used
breast_gene_summary <- data.table(
  Total_breast_cancer_genes_in_list = length(breast_genes),
  Breast_cancer_genes_mutated_in_cohort = length(present_breast_genes),
  Possible_pairwise_tests = ifelse(
    length(present_breast_genes) >= 2,
    choose(length(present_breast_genes), 2),
    0
  )
)

print(breast_gene_summary)

cat("\nBreast cancer genes present in MAF:\n")
print(present_breast_genes)

cat("\nBreast cancer genes absent/not mutated in MAF:\n")
print(missing_breast_genes)

# Save gene-level summary
fwrite(
  breast_gene_summary,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_breast_gene_somatic_interaction_summary.csv")
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Breast_cancer_genes_present = present_breast_genes),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_breast_genes_present_for_interaction.csv")
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Breast_cancer_genes_missing = missing_breast_genes),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_breast_genes_missing_for_interaction.csv")
)


# ============================================================
# Run somatic interaction only if at least 2 breast genes present
# ============================================================

if (length(present_breast_genes) >= 2) {

  breast_interaction_table <- tryCatch(
    {
      somaticInteractions(
        maf = maf_nonsilent,
        genes = present_breast_genes,
        pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
        returnAll = TRUE
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] Breast cancer gene somaticInteractions failed: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  # ============================================================
  # Save full interaction table
  # ============================================================

  if (!is.null(breast_interaction_table)) {

    breast_interaction_table <- as.data.table(breast_interaction_table)

    fwrite(
      breast_interaction_table,
      file = file.path(
        table_dir,
        "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_all_pairs.csv"
      )
    )

    message(
      file.path(
        table_dir,
        "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_all_pairs.csv"
      )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save significant pairs only
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    p_col <- intersect(
      c("pValue", "p.value", "pvalue", "P.value", "PValue"),
      colnames(breast_interaction_table)
    )

    if (length(p_col) > 0) {

      p_col <- p_col[1]

      breast_interaction_table[
        ,
        FDR := p.adjust(get(p_col), method = "BH")
      ]

      breast_sig_interactions <- breast_interaction_table[
        get(p_col) < 0.05
      ]

      fwrite(
        breast_sig_interactions,
        file = file.path(
          table_dir,
          "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_significant_pairs_p005.csv"
        )
      )

      breast_fdr_sig_interactions <- breast_interaction_table[
        FDR < 0.05
      ]

      fwrite(
        breast_fdr_sig_interactions,
        file = file.path(
          table_dir,
          "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes_FDR005_pairs.csv"
        )
      )

      cat("\nNumber of nominally significant breast cancer gene pairs, p < 0.05:\n")
      print(nrow(breast_sig_interactions))

      cat("\nNumber of FDR-significant breast cancer gene pairs, FDR < 0.05:\n")
      print(nrow(breast_fdr_sig_interactions))

      if (nrow(breast_sig_interactions) > 0) {
        cat("\nNominally significant breast cancer gene interaction pairs:\n")
        print(breast_sig_interactions)
      }

    } else {
      message("[WARNING] Could not identify p-value column in interaction table.")
    }
  }


  # ============================================================
  # Save PDF plot
  # ============================================================

  pdf(
    file.path(
      plot_dir,
      "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes.pdf"
    ),
    width = 12,
    height = 10
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()


  # ============================================================
  # Save PNG plot
  # ============================================================

  png(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      "Tier1_common_somatic_interactions_breast_genes.png"
    ),
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  dev.off()


  # ============================================================
  # Show plot in Rmd output
  # ============================================================

  try(
    somaticInteractions(
      maf = maf_nonsilent,
      genes = present_breast_genes,
      pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
      returnAll = TRUE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

} else {
  message(
    "[INFO] Fewer than 2 breast cancer genes are mutated in this cohort; ",
    "somatic interaction analysis cannot be performed."
  )
}
```

```{r}
## TCGA/ICGC breast cancer gene somatic interactions

tcga_icgc_gene_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/Unique_genes_TCGA_ICGC.txt"

# Read TCGA/ICGC gene list: one gene per line
tcga_icgc_genes <- fread(tcga_icgc_gene_file, header = FALSE)$V1
tcga_icgc_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(tcga_icgc_genes)))
tcga_icgc_genes <- tcga_icgc_genes[tcga_icgc_genes != "" & !is.na(tcga_icgc_genes)]

# Keep only genes mutated in this cohort
gene_summary_dt <- as.data.table(gene_summary)
gene_summary_dt[, Hugo_upper := toupper(Hugo_Symbol)]

tcga_icgc_genes_present <- unique(
  gene_summary_dt[Hugo_upper %in% tcga_icgc_genes, Hugo_Symbol]
)

cat("\nTotal TCGA/ICGC genes:", length(tcga_icgc_genes), "\n")
cat("TCGA/ICGC genes mutated in cohort:", length(tcga_icgc_genes_present), "\n")
cat("Possible pairwise tests:", choose(length(tcga_icgc_genes_present), 2), "\n")

if (length(tcga_icgc_genes_present) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than 2 TCGA/ICGC genes are mutated; cannot run somatic interaction analysis.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run somaticInteractions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tmp_pdf <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
pdf(tmp_pdf)

tcga_icgc_interactions <- somaticInteractions(
  maf = maf_nonsilent,
  genes = tcga_icgc_genes_present,
  pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01),
  returnAll = TRUE
)

dev.off()
unlink(tmp_pdf)

tcga_icgc_interactions <- as.data.table(tcga_icgc_interactions)

# Add FDR
tcga_icgc_interactions[, FDR := p.adjust(pValue, method = "BH")]

# Significant pairs
sig_p005 <- tcga_icgc_interactions[pValue < 0.05]
sig_fdr005 <- tcga_icgc_interactions[FDR < 0.05]

cat("\nNominally significant pairs, p < 0.05:", nrow(sig_p005), "\n")
cat("FDR-significant pairs, FDR < 0.05:", nrow(sig_fdr005), "\n")

# Save tables
fwrite(
  tcga_icgc_interactions,
  file.path(table_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_all_pairs_with_FDR.csv")
)

fwrite(
  sig_p005,
  file.path(table_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_significant_pairs_p005.csv")
)

fwrite(
  sig_fdr005,
  file.path(table_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_significant_pairs_FDR005.csv")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract genes involved in nominally significant pairs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sig_pair_genes <- unique(c(sig_p005$gene1, sig_p005$gene2))
sig_pair_genes <- sig_pair_genes[!is.na(sig_pair_genes) & sig_pair_genes != ""]

cat("Nominal significant pairs:", nrow(sig_p005), "\n")
cat("Unique genes in those pairs:", length(sig_pair_genes), "\n")
cat("Pairwise tests in focused plot:", choose(length(sig_pair_genes), 2), "\n")

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = sig_pair_genes),
  file.path(table_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_genes_in_nominal_significant_pairs_for_plot.csv")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save focused plot only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  file.path(plot_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_nominal_sig_genes_only.pdf"),
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)

somaticInteractions(
  maf = maf_nonsilent,
  genes = sig_pair_genes,
  pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01)
)

dev.off()

png(
  file.path(plot_dir, "TCGA_ICGC_somatic_interactions_nominal_sig_genes_only.png"),
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)

somaticInteractions(
  maf = maf_nonsilent,
  genes = sig_pair_genes,
  pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01)
)

dev.off()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Display only final focused plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

somaticInteractions(
  maf = maf_nonsilent,
  genes = sig_pair_genes,
  pvalue = c(0.05, 0.01)
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Detecting cancer driver genes based on positional clustering
# maftools::oncodrive / OncodriveCLUST-style analysis
# ============================================================

oncodrive_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "Oncodrive_Positional_Clustering")
dir.create(oncodrive_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Candidate amino-acid/protein-change columns commonly present in PCGR/vcf2maf/MAF files.
aa_candidates <- c(
  "Protein_Change",
  "HGVSp_Short",
  "HGVSp",
  "AAChange",
  "Amino_Acid_Change"
)

aa_col <- aa_candidates[aa_candidates %in% colnames(combined_maf)][1]

if (is.na(aa_col) || length(aa_col) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No amino-acid change column found. oncodrive requires a protein-change column such as ",
    "Protein_Change, HGVSp_Short, HGVSp, AAChange, or Amino_Acid_Change.\n",
    "Available columns are:\n",
    paste(colnames(combined_maf), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

message("Using amino-acid change column for oncodrive: ", aa_col)

# Minimum mutation count per gene.
# For small cohorts, 3 is useful as exploratory.
# For stricter/default maftools behavior, change this to 5.
min_mut_oncodrive <- 3

# Optional: ignore very large / frequently polymorphic genes.
ignore_genes_oncodrive <- c(
  "TTN", "MUC16", "MUC4", "MUC5B", "MUC6", "MUC17",
  "OBSCN", "RYR1", "RYR2", "RYR3", "DNAH5", "DNAH7", "DNAH9"
)

ignore_genes_oncodrive <- intersect(ignore_genes_oncodrive, gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol)

# ============================================================
# Run oncodrive
# ============================================================

oncodrive_res <- tryCatch(
  {
    oncodrive(
      maf = maf_nonsilent,
      AACol = aa_col,
      minMut = min_mut_oncodrive,
      pvalMethod = "zscore",
      ignoreGenes = ignore_genes_oncodrive
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("[ERROR] oncodrive failed: ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  }
)

if (!is.null(oncodrive_res) && nrow(oncodrive_res) > 0) {

  oncodrive_res_dt <- as.data.table(oncodrive_res)

  sort_cols <- intersect(c("fdr", "pval"), colnames(oncodrive_res_dt))
  if (length(sort_cols) > 0) {
    setorderv(oncodrive_res_dt, cols = sort_cols, order = rep(1, length(sort_cols)))
  }

  # Save full result table
  fwrite(
    oncodrive_res_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_all_results.tsv"),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  write.csv(
    oncodrive_res_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_all_results.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Save significant/candidate driver genes
  if ("fdr" %in% colnames(oncodrive_res_dt)) {
    oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[fdr <= 0.10]
  } else if ("pval" %in% colnames(oncodrive_res_dt)) {
    oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[pval <= 0.05]
  } else {
    oncodrive_sig <- oncodrive_res_dt[0]
  }


  write.csv(
    oncodrive_sig,
    file = file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_significant_candidates.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  message("Saved oncodrive all-results table: ",
          file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_all_results.csv"))

  message("Saved oncodrive significant/candidate table: ",
          file.path(table_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_significant_candidates.csv"))

  print(head(oncodrive_res_dt, 20))
  message("Number of FDR <= 0.10 positional-clustering candidates: ", nrow(oncodrive_sig))

  # ============================================================
  # Save oncodrive plots
  # ============================================================

  pdf(
    file.path(plot_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_FDR0.10.pdf"),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  try(
    plotOncodrive(
      res = oncodrive_res_dt,
      fdrCutOff = 0.10,
      useFraction = TRUE,
      labelSize = 0.7
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  dev.off()

  png(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, "Tier1_common_oncodrive_positional_clustering_FDR0.10.png"),
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    units = "in",
    res = 300
  )
  try(
    plotOncodrive(
      res = oncodrive_res_dt,
      fdrCutOff = 0.10,
      useFraction = TRUE,
      labelSize = 0.7
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  dev.off()

  # Show in Rmd output
  plotOncodrive(
    res = oncodrive_res_dt,
    fdrCutOff = 0.10,
    useFraction = TRUE,
    labelSize = 0.7
  )

} else {
  message(
    "No oncodrive results returned. Possible reasons: too few recurrently mutated genes, ",
    "missing/poorly formatted protein-change values in ", aa_col, ", or minMut is too strict. ",
    "Try min_mut_oncodrive <- 2 for exploratory analysis."
  )
}
```
